Copy: 
Slide 1: Five Ways to Connect with Spirit Through Rituals of Adornment 
Slide 2:  Perhaps you are already working with jewelry ritually subconsciously, or maybe you are already ritually minded, casting spells with your sacred and favorite pieces. Here are five ways to connect with spirit through rituals of adornment.Slide 3: 1. Wearing Jewelry to Set an Intention 
Call on rituals of adornment to help set intentions. To do this, first, cleanse the piece using sacred smoke, salt, or crystals. Then, hold the jewelry in both your hands. Speak your intention over the jewelry three times. Slide 4: 2. Adornment as a Protection Spell Speak a spell of protection over your rings, earrings, necklaces, and bracelets, and feel them absorb any negative energy that comes your way. Use healing smoke to cleanse your pieces, place them in a dish of salt, or allow them to sit in the light of the moon to help clear any energy from your day-to-day.
Slide 5: 3. Rituals of Adornment to Ground and Center 
Adorning yourself with jewelry intentionally imbued with the healing power of crystals can balance, support and transform your energetic body. When you feel your energy become low, chaotic or detached, simply pause, touch the necklace you’re intentionally wearing, and take a deep breath. 
Slide 6: 4. Connecting with the Moon’s Magic through Jewelry 
Place your jewelry on a windowsill or inside a bit of silk outside to absorb the glow and energy of the moon. You might feel called to do this on a new moon phase if you wish to enchant your jewelry with the energy of new beginnings or intention setting, or on a full moon if you wish to charge your jewelry with the powers of release, wholeness, or celebration. 
Slide 7: 5. Wearing Jewelry as Ancestral Veneration 
By wearing jewelry handed down through your family, you honor those who came before you, working with your body as an altar. If you don’t have a relationship with your ancestors, or heirlooms to wear,  you can purchase auspicious pieces of jewelry in the name and honor of a specific family member, or acquire jewelry that is special to you to pass down to the next generation, as you will one day be a benevolent ancestor. Slide 8: Read the full blog post here (this would just be in the story set)

Slide One: What is the Shadow Self? & Why Should I Connect with It?
Slide Two: Everyone has a Shadow Self. The term was popularized by psychiatrist & psychoanalyst Carl Jung, & refers to an unconscious part of a person that constitutes a blind spot or repressed traits. Perhaps you’re prone to jealousy, reactivity, or judgment. The Shadow is somehow deemed “not ideal” and therefore not integrated with the whole individual, existing just out of sight.  
Slide Three: Image
Slide Four: Invite your demons to tea. 
Slide Five: Their wisdom may surprise you. 
Slide Six: Your Shadow Self longs to be accepted & seen. It asks you to get curious about the parts of yourself that you reject, so that you can live a more empowered and authentic life. 
Slide Seven: The Shadow offers wisdom and clarity. It celebrates your wholeness. 
Slide Eight: Honor &  integrate your Shadow through ritual, journaling, meditation, practicing non-judgment, & working with a professional. 
Slide Nine: Your Shadow Self is full of rich wisdom, lessons, and deep self-love.

Moving forward with confidence and harmony
I affirm that my inner fire is always lit. I tend to this fire as it urges me forward with clarity, passion, and creativity toward my most-aligned life.
I affirm that like the tides I move in my own authentic way. I honor my cycles, I nurture my inner life, and as water does, I freely express myself.
I affirm that I bring beauty and harmony to all that I do. My magic honors the scales of life,  knowing that balance is a continuous process.

I affirm that I am in intuitive flow, transforming all the time. I seek truth as I explore the depths of my psyche, carrying a lantern of wisdom, unafraid of the dark.

As I step into my season, I honor my inner wisdom and the clarity it brings. I embrace my meticulous nature as a gift, knowing that my attention to detail creates a life of purpose and alignment. I trust in my ability to nurture, organize, and bring my visions into reality.

I affirm that I am a seeker of truth, constantly expanding my horizons and embracing the freedom to live authentically. I am both the match and the flame. With every step, I forge a trail of boundless possibilities, guided by the unwavering light of my curious spirit.
